<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values using double edge clocking.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractional divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">Number of clock cycles required for multiplication by 2 in the frequency divider.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_BY_HALF">Value representing half of MUL2_DIV_CLK.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="even_clk">Intermediate even clock signal after multiplying by 2.</signal>
        <signal id="odd_clk">Intermediate odd clock signal after multiplying by 2.</signal>
        <signal id="half_clk">Half of the input clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="phase_shftd_clk">Phase shifted clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="div_cnt">Count value for division operation.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt_even_odd">Count value for even/odd determination.</signal>
        <signal id="even_odd">Signal indicating whether current clock is even or odd.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Phase Shifter Logic
        assign half_clk = clk >> 1;
        
        // Count Value Calculation
        assign div_cnt = cnt_even_odd + DIV_BY_HALF;
        
        // Even/Odd Clock Generation
        assign even_clk = clk & ~even_odd;
        assign odd_clk = clk | even_odd;
        
        // Counter Initialization
        assign cnt_even_odd = div_cnt % MUL2_DIV_CLK;
        assign even_odd = div_cnt >= MUL2_DIV_CLK ? 1 : 0;
        
        // Output Signal Assignment
        assign clk_div = even_clk | odd_clk;
    </implementation>
</module>
